name: ProGroCo | Zprite
description:
Lineage: Blue dream cookie chemchee x Jelly Roll

Type: Hybrid 

Terpenes: limonene, myrcene, caryophyllene, & pinene 

Effects: Uplifting and energizing at first, with a creative, social buzz and mood-brightening euphoria. Smooth transition into a relaxed, easygoing body high without heavy sedation. Perfect for daytime hangs, creative sessions, or sparking up a party.

Aroma: Bursting with sweet lemon-lime soda, candy zest, and a subtle herbal undertone. Opens up with bright citrus and finishes with a creamy, fizzy sweetness.
